description.zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置。显示为空表示数据已经读取完毕。
description.en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned.
The ID of the region where the Service Mesh (ASM) instance is located.
A list of Service Mesh instance IDs.
A required parameter. The value must be `servicemesh`.

description.zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项。
description.en: A list of tags. It can contain up to 20 items.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type servicemesh --resource-id c418807cb4e5840eab018da7d8f5d0000 --tag Value=yahaha Key=test --next-token example-string --region cn-hangzhou
